chunks: As for whatever is in it from ʿĀmir ibn Nuʿaym al-Qummī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿĀmir ibn Nuʿaym al-Qummī.

key_terms.الْقُمِّيِّ: A nisbah indicating attribution to Qum
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: From his father, indicating a link in the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from ʿĀmir ibn Nuʿaym al-Qummī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿĀmir ibn Nuʿaym al-Qummī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission for hadith preservation and source verification.
